notes.title: Upcoming Game Release
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Ultimate General American Revolution will be released on Steam in just a few days! Get ready to dive into this immersive sandbox 4X strategy game set during the American Revolution. Command armies, forge alliances, and shape history in this epic era of conflict and change.

We extend our heartfelt thanks to all our fans for your unwavering support. Your passion and enthusiasm have been crucial in bringing this game to life. We can't wait for you to experience the adventure and craft your own revolutionary story.

Stay tuned for the launch and join the game soon!
